# DO NOT PRINT: tiny synthetic workflow demo

This is an own source-constructed contract fixture, not a real user project or live backend/printer configuration. All glyphs are geometric stand-ins, NOT printable lettering. Never send this tray to a printer. The baseline/workbook pair was used by the staged real HTTP candidate-generation tests; resulting candidate contracts have native archive/schema evidence, not full GUI composition certification.

Choose DO_NOT_PRINT_grid.xlsx and DO_NOT_PRINT_synthetic.PRINT. Worksheet: Samples. Range: B2:E3. Delimiter: slash. Channel order: CMYKWT.

On the XY view, enclose the central 2-row by 4-column sample region (x approximately 29.25 to 82.75 mm; y 39.25 to 66.75 mm), the row-label region on its left (x 11.25 to 16.75; y 39.25 to 66.75), and the column-label region below (x 29.25 to 85.75; y 27.25 to 29.75). Update proposals and choose the identity orientation: no transpose or row/column mirror, zero offsets. Check which workbook cells are holes, then preview/save only a new unverified candidate. These are aggregate regions, not mesh intersection proofs.

Original generated artifact references:
- Native fixture build: portable_variants/case_profile/baseline_colorpicker.print
- Own workbook build: fixtures/variants/case_profile/workbook.xlsx
